name: Civil unrest
summary: Mass social protests in France for a third weekend, spreading to Germany
state: France saw a third weekend of social protests on 31 Oct, with about 320,000 marchers by the Interior Ministry's count, down from 550,000 on 17 Oct, and 27 arrests by mid-afternoon. Protests spread to Germany, and rioting in Barcelona on 24 Oct led to about 130 arrests. Indian authorities detained thousands at protests earlier in October.
for_you: If you are travelling to France, expect transport disruption on protest days and avoid demonstrations. Check FCDO travel advice for France.
rubric_hit: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.

sources.title: Euronews — France's third weekend of social protests

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
